header.boot_time_note: Not reset by "Shut down" with Fast Startup (the Windows default), sleep or hibernation; reset by a restart.

reason.not_on_this_os: this version of Windows does not keep this record
reason.not_admin: Windows would not show this without administrator rights
reason.not_attempted: this was not read — the scan stopped before reaching it
reason.service_disabled: the Windows service that writes this record is switched off
reason.source_absent: this PC has no such record to read
reason.source_empty: the place this is kept is there and holds nothing
reason.partial: part of this was read and part of it was not
reason.budget_spent: this program stopped reading before it finished
reason.collector_unavailable: this build does not read that
reason.not_consented: only a full scan reads this, and this was the standard scan
reason.other_volume: this is on another drive, and this program reads only the system drive's change journal

row_band.found: The source held only {{from}} to {{to}} when it was read; what is counted here is from that span.
row_band.not_found: Nothing within this span: {{from}} to {{to}}, what the source held when it was read. Nothing before it was seen.
row_band.none: The source held no record when it was read, so there is no span in which anything could be seen.

falsepositives: Ordinary things that also produce this

scope.not_admin: Scope: {{checks}} check(s) could not be answered because this scan does not have administrator rights. Running it again as administrator answers them.
scope.not_attempted: Scope: {{checks}} check(s) could not be answered because this program stopped reading before it reached what they ask about. That is this program's limit, not a finding about this PC.
scope.not_consented: Scope: {{checks}} check(s) were not answered because they read only in a full scan, and the standard scan was chosen. A full scan asks before it starts.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.note: The times this report holds, oldest first. An order of recorded times is not an order of events, and a record that is absent was not necessarily removed. A time a folder listing reports is what the file system says, which the program that wrote the file can set.
timeline.coverage_note: Nothing can be read from a source outside the span it can show.

trace_ages.title: How far back the traces reach
trace_ages.note: How far back each source reaches on this PC, beside when parts of this PC were set up. A source that reaches back only a short way is ordinary on many PCs; the causes are listed under each row. Nothing here is evidence on its own, and the report cannot prove a PC is clean.
trace_ages.anchors: When parts of this PC were set up
trace_ages.sources: How far back each source reaches

conclusion.no_suspicious_evidence: No suspicious evidence in the sources examined
conclusion.high_confidence: High-confidence evidence that needs the checker's analysis

conclusion_note.no_suspicious_evidence: None of the defined indicators was found in the sources that could be read. This is NOT a statement that the PC is clean: software cannot see another PC, DMA hardware, compromised firmware or a reinstalled Windows.
conclusion_note.inconclusive: Too much could not be examined (for example without administrator rights) for the absence of alerts to mean anything.
conclusion_note.manual_review: One source shows something that deserves a person's review. Read the legitimate explanations listed before concluding anything.
conclusion_note.corroborated: Indicators came from two or more independent sources. Each still has legitimate explanations to consider.
conclusion_note.high_confidence: A specific indicator (FLAG) is corroborated by another independent source. This needs the checker's analysis; it is not an automatic conviction.

assessment.sources: Independent sources with an alert: {{sources}} · with FLAG: {{flags}}
assessment.proximity: Temporal proximity of {{minutes}} min between "{{a}}" and "{{b}}". Proximity is not causation.

caveat.software_only: A software check inside Windows cannot see cheats on another PC, DMA devices that imitate ordinary hardware, compromised firmware or traces removed by reinstalling Windows.
caveat.not_elevated: The scan ran without administrator rights; several sources could not be read.
caveat.standard_tier: Standard scan: the advanced sources (browsers, user files, Explorer lists, PowerShell commands) were not read.
caveat.categories_not_checked: Some categories could not be checked on this machine.

tools.title: Roblox tools
tools.intro: Every source this scan read, matched against a catalog of Roblox launchers, FastFlag tools, FPS unlockers, executors and injectors. A status summarises evidence for a reviewer; it is not a verdict.
tools.none: No catalog name in the sources that were read. This holds only for the sources listed below.

status_note.corroborated: Execution, an executor layout, executor-only scripts or a module in the Roblox player, seen by two or more independent sources.
status_note.detected: Execution, an executor layout, executor-only scripts or a module in the Roblox player, seen by one source.
status_note.suspected: An executor or injector name in a Roblox context, with nothing showing it ran.
status_note.info: A legitimate launcher or utility, a generic term, a partial name or an ambiguous name without Roblox context.

tools.missing: a recorded file is not at its path today (not necessarily deleted)
